note: INT-1 (ADR-0096 D2/D5 golden routing ratchet). Scored end-to-end by apps/quoky/src/personal-v2-acceptance.test.ts against the production AppModule: `route` is the registered handler id that claimed the turn, `runtime` (a deterministic runtime branch: help, post-push replies) or `classifier` (fell through to intent classification/chat). `kind` is the work-chat command kind; `reply` labels a runtime reply; `providerCalls: 0` pins a deterministic turn (on a `classifier` route it pins a deterministic chat-path reply after classification, labelled `reply: own-memory-not-found` for the v3 W3-L01 own-memory question with no recall hit). `ctx.openTodos` are added through the to-do handler first; `ctx.applyAnchor` seeds a post-push apply-preview anchor; `ctx.registeredProject` registers a real sandbox git repository first and `ctx.priorTurns` are sent after it (v3 W1-L01). CAL-2 (ADR-0110): the harness configures a calendar whose reader is a fixed offline fixture, so `calendar` (pre-classify 150) is a registered route; with no calendar configured the handler is absent and the QUAL-7 classifier route is unchanged (pinned by the intent-routing suite and the calendar composition test).
